description: Answers 'what was inflation (or GDP, payrolls, retail sales) as first published on this date - not as later revised?' Give a series id (for example CPIAUCSL) and as_of; optionally start. Returns the series as actually published by as_of, with every vintage kept, across 22,700+ macro series (finzdata.com). Free keys get the last 12 months; full history and every vintage with a FinzData plan.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: get_macro_vintage
title: Get macro vintage
